vdAgreeIntro: You will see other people's names and bookings. By continuing you agree that:
vdAgree1: You use this access only for the work you were given, and only during the session.
vdAgree2: You do not copy, photograph, share or keep anyone's details on any device.
vdAgree3: You keep what you see confidential, also after you stop volunteering.
vdAgree4: You mark only what really happened, and only you use this account. Every search and mark is recorded under your name.
vdAgreeTick: I have read this and I agree
